item.title: Huge dip/pothole in yellow box where Aylesbury Road meets Westmoreland Road, 24th November
item.description:
Yellow box where Aylesbury Road meets Westmoreland Road - there is a huge dip in the road that has been getting worse by the day. It was reported back in July (ref 9733410) and is much worse now. Going above 5mph is likely to cause damage to bumpers or tyres, plus cars are swerving to avoid the massive dip, which is obviously hazardous at an extremely busy junction.

item.title: Unauthorised wooden forecourt structure and bins obstructing public pavement outside 126A Upper Wickham Lane, 24th November
item.description:
A large timber and plastic-sheeted enclosure (approximately 1.8m–2m high) has been erected at the front of 126A Upper Wickham Lane (La Yanis Shisha Lounge), adjacent to the public footway. Please inspect whether this structure—along with commercial wheelie bins and any associated furniture—is encroaching onto the adopted public highway/pavement without a valid pavement licence, narrowing the footpath and obstructing pedestrians (including wheelchair users and pushchairs). Additionally, please forward this to Bexley Planning Enforcement to verify whether planning permission has been granted for a structure exceeding 1 metre in height adjacent to a highway and for change of use to a shisha lounge.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 118, Upper Wickham Lane, Welling, Greater London
